label: The conducting cross-section
subgoals: Subtract twice the barrier from the width
Subtract one barrier thickness from the height
Divide the copper area by the drawn area

label: Resistance penalty of the liner
subgoals: Compute the copper area with the barrier removed
Form the ratio of drawn area to copper area
Convert the ratio into a percentage increase

label: Width-dependent resistivity
subgoals: Compute the copper width after the barrier
Combine the resistivity with the copper cross-section and length
